connector.name: Storesignal
connector.registryDescription: Shopify store intelligence: apps, tech stack, CDN, and market data over a 19K-store corpus.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package storesignal-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the anthesiallc account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
